pages.heading: Void Worm
pages.body: Optional End boss. Transform Crimson Mosquito Larva in a Capsid into a Mysterious Worm, then throw that into the End void to summon it. Focus damage on the

pages.heading: Void Worm (cont.)
pages.body: head: destroying body segments splits the threat. Its eye and mandibles help make a Dimensional Carver, which opens temporary spawn-linked portals with limited uses. Server travel restrictions still need to be respected.
